text.p: Typhoon Zane will track eastward south of Japan and north of the Volcano Islands this period as top winds decrease from near 80 mph to near 50 mph during the next 36 hours. Typhoon Yates will weaken also from near 80 mph to near 50 mph during this period as it tracks into open waters well southeast of Japan. These systems will both become extratropical during the next 36 hours and will be hazardous to shipping.

Tropical Storm Hernan, 300 miles south southwest of Acapulco, is moving west northwest. Top winds, near 40 mph, will likely increase this period. The storm may turn more to the north with time, eventually threatening Mexico, but at this time it is only a threat to shipping.
Tropical Depression Genevieve, well southwest of southern Baja, will become less of a threat to shipping as top winds drop to near 30 mph this period. The storm will drift west northwestward.

Tropical Storm Isidore, with 40 mph winds, is centered 800 miles southwest of the Azores, moving north at 20 mph. This track and strength will continue through the next 24 hours. The storm is a moderate threat to shipping.
